workload: Generated-key notes with title, body, pinned, updated, and tint. separate_saves calls saveChanges once per note and reopens the context on the same database, then exports the image once. delete_one and delete_all seed with one saveChanges, then time the deleting saveChanges and the following exportImage. A fresh memory database is used for every sample.
os_version: Linux 6.12.94+ #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon Oct 19 22:12:29 UTC 2026
population_variance_definition: The integer floor of the population variance of the microsecond samples: sum((sample - mean)^2) / sample_count.
limitations: Linux x64 only when the AOT executable is run there. This is not macOS, Windows, Android, iOS, or a phone, and it is not a native SQLite comparison. RSS is the whole process. orm_save_batch_linux_x64.json and scenarios_10k_linux_x64.json are different workloads and are not deltas for these samples.
